name: Metrics
description: This folder contains Metrics based dashboards for Squid Proxy App

children.name: Squid Proxy - IP Domain DNS Statistics
children.description: The Squid Proxy -  IP Domain DNS Statistics dashboard provides a high-level view of the number of IPs,  the number of FQDN, rate requests cache according to FQDN, rate requests cache according to IPs, the number of DNS queries, time for DNS query.
children.title: Squid Proxy - IP Domain DNS Statistics

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheIpRequests proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | delta |filter sum>0| sum
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheIpHits proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | delta |filter sum >0| sum
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheFqdnRequests proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | delta| filter sum>0 |sum
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheFqdnMisses proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} |delta| filter sum>0 | sum

panels.title: Number of FQDN Cache Negative Hits

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheFqdnNegativeHits proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} |delta|filter sum>0|  sum

panels.title: Number of External Dns Server Requests

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheDnsRequests proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | avg by proxy_cluster,host|delta | filter sum >0

panels.title: Filter Defintion:
panels.text: ###Host : Host is the hostname of Squid Proxy server

children.name: Squid Proxy - Performance
children.description: The Squid Proxy -  Performance dashboard provides an insight into the workload of clusters, the number of page faults IO,  percent of file descriptor used, number of memory used, the time for all HTTP requests, the number of objects in the cache, the CPU time.
children.title: Squid Proxy - Performance

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheSysNumReads proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}| avg by proxy_cluster,host

panels.title: Percent of  File Descriptors Used Over Time

queries.queryString: (metric=squid_cacheCurrentFileDescrCnt or metric=squid_cacheCurrentUnusedFDescrCnt) and proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}| sum by proxy_cluster,host
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheNumObjCount proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}| avg by proxy_cluster,host
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheCpuTime proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | avg by proxy_cluster,host
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheMaxResSize proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | avg by proxy_cluster,host | eval _value/1024
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheCurrentResFileDescrCnt proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | avg by proxy_cluster,host

panels.title: Average Time Served For All HTTP Requests
Filter Defintion:
panels.text: ###Host : Host is the hostname of Squid Proxy server

children.name: Squid Proxy - Protocol
children.description: The Squid Proxy -  Protocol dashboard provides an insight into the protocols of clusters: the number of HTTP requests, HTTP errors, total bytes transferred, the number of HTTP requests per second, the number of HTTP's bytes per second.
children.title: Squid Proxy - Protocol

panels.title: HTTP Requests Errors Sent to Clients per Second
HTTP KB's Received From Clients Per Second
HTTP KB's Sent to Clients Per Second
All Requests From  Clients Per Second
Total of All Requests From  Clients

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheServerRequests proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | delta | filter sum>0|sum

panels.title: Total of HTTP Errors Sent  Clients

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/squid* metric=squid_cacheHttpErrors proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | delta | filter sum>0 |sum

panels.title: KB's of Traffic Received From Servers Per Second
KB's of Traffic Sent From Servers Per Second

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/squid* (metric=squid_cacheHttpInKb or metric=squid_cacheHttpOutKb ) proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | delta |filter sum>0| sum | eval _value/1024
_sourceCategory = Labs/squid* (metric=squid_cacheServerInKb or metric=squid_cacheServerOutKb ) proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}} | delta |filter sum>0| sum | eval _value/1024
